name: @nbiish/giizhendam-aabajichiganan-mcp

tools.name: orchestrate_agents
tools.description: Runs configured CLI agents (sequential or parallel) on the given prompt. Uses Gemini 2.5 Pro via OpenRouter to choose between sequential and parallel, and to synthesize a consolidated markdown report. Outputs per-agent artifacts and a final synthesis file into AGENT_OUTPUT_DIR.

prompt_text.description: Primary task prompt passed into each configured CLI agent.

tools.name: finance_experts
tools.description: Orchestrates 18 financial expert agents using the configured orchestrator model (google/gemini-2.5-pro) via OpenRouter. Each expert provides analysis (900 token limit) saved to individual files. Then uses the orchestrator model with File Search RAG to consolidate all expert outputs into enterprise-ready, production-grade analysis and strategic advisory. Generates comprehensive orchestrator prompt to guide CLI tools/experts in execution.

topic.description: Financial topic for expert deliberation (e.g., 'Financial risks of Project X').

output_filename.description: Optional filename for output. Defaults to sanitized topic.

tools.name: ceo_and_board
tools.description: Simulates a board discussion on a given topic using the configured orchestrator model (google/gemini-2.5-pro) via OpenRouter. This deliberation includes formulating a recommended orchestrator prompt for the user to execute based on the discussion. Saves the simulated discussion and recommendation to a file in './ceo-and-board/'.

topic.description: Topic for board discussion (e.g., 'Q3 Strategy Review').

roles.description: Optional board roles. Uses standard roles if not provided.

output_filename.description: Optional filename. Defaults to sanitized topic.
